sources.snippet: Model Summary SexyGPT-v2-Thinking-Female is a specialized language model fine-tuned for conversational AI with extended reasoning capabilities. Based on Qwen3-0.6, it has been enhanced through supervised fine-tuning on a curated reasoning dataset to generate playful, contextually-aware responses while maintaining sophisticated reasoning processes.
